【ETH见底了吗？我不这么认为——我认为它正在筑底】

先说结论：当前不是ETH的底部，但可能正在接近底部区域。

很多人看到恐惧指数20就喊抄底，我不反对，但我要把逻辑拆清楚。

第一个信号：ETH从高位下来跌了将近64%，这是什么概念？差不多打了三折还多。历史上每一次这种幅度的回调，事后看都是黄金坑，但坑里有没有刀，你得自己判断。当前价格1788美元，正好卡在1725支撑和1869阻力之间窄幅震荡，24小时才涨了1%，7天涨了9.2%，这种走势说明多空双方都在观望，等一个方向。

第二个信号才是重点：市场已经恐惧到骨子里了，恐惧贪婪指数长期维持在20附近晃悠。说真的，这种时候往往是最危险的时刻——不是行情危险，是你的判断容易被人带偏。大部分人看到恐惧就割肉，看到暴涨就追高，历史一直在重复。

第三个信号：成交量突然放大，超过市值的5%。这意味着什么？有人在大笔买卖，机构或者大户在调仓。至于是抄底还是出货，看你怎么理解。

我的判断是：ETH的基本面没变，Ethereum还是那个Ethereum，质押率还在，TVL也没崩。当前更多是宏观情绪和流动性问题导致的非理性杀跌。

记住这一点：在别人恐惧时贪婪没错，但别一次性把子弹打完，分批建仓，留有余地。

title: CHỢ ĐẦU TƯ HÔM NAY: LẠI LÀ CHIÊU "RŨ HÀNG" CỦA CÁ MẬP?
subTitle:
Mấy ngày nay lướt qua mấy hội nhóm đầu tư, từ chứng khoán, vàng cho đến crypto, đâu đâu cũng thấy một bầu không khí "im hơi lặng tiếng". Chợ búa ảm đạm thế này dễ làm anh em nản lòng nghía sang chỗ khác đúng không? Nhưng khoan vội tắt app, ngồi xuống làm ngụm cafe rồi cùng lướt qua xem dòng tiền thực sự đang chạy đi đâu nhé!
Sếp lớn Fed vẫn "rắn", chứng khoán - vàng đi ngang thở khẽ Tâm lý bao trùm cả thị trường tuần này vẫn là sự thận trọng sau đợt họp FOMC vừa qua. Phía Fed liên tục phát đi tín hiệu "thắt chặt lãi suất lâu hơn dự kiến" để đè lạm phát, khiến dòng tiền lớn có phần e dè.
Chứng khoán Mỹ: Nhóm cổ phiếu công nghệ (đặc biệt là các ông lớn AI) đang bị điều chỉnh nhẹ sau chuỗi ngày tăng nóng.
Giá vàng: Vàng thế giới đang loay hoay giữ vùng hỗ trợ quanh $4,150/ounce. Nhìn chung, phe ôm vàng tầm này đang chuyển sang trạng thái "phòng thủ", chủ yếu tích lũy dài hạn chứ không còn sóng để lướt nữa.
Thị trường Crypto: Giá giảm, nhưng "Adoption" (ứng dụng) lại tăng! Chợ coin cũng chịu áp lực chung khi chỉ số Sợ hãi (Fear & Greed) tụt hẳn về vùng tiêu cực.
Bitcoin ($BTC): Vừa có một cú quét lệnh Margin khiến giá lùi về dập dìu quanh mốc $64,000. Đám đông thì thi nhau đoán đáy mới, thậm chí sợ hãi đặt cược giá về $52k. Nhưng nhìn sang dữ liệu On-chain, anh em sẽ thấy một thực tế hoàn toàn trái ngược: Số lượng BTC trên các sàn giao dịch lớn liên tục sụt giảm, chứng tỏ cá mập chỉ chờ nhỏ lẻ hoảng sợ xả hàng là tụt xích... gom sạch đưa về ví lạnh cất giấu.
💡 "BẮT ĐÁY" GIAI ĐOẠN NÀY: TẠI SAO PHẢI LÀ ETHEREUM ($ETH)? Trong lúc cả chợ đang xanh xanh đỏ đỏ hoang mang, nếu các bác muốn tìm một nơi trú ẩn an toàn mà vẫn có đòn bẩy tăng trưởng tốt cho danh mục, thì Ethereum ($ETH) chính là câu trả lời sáng giá nhất tầm này.
Giá ETH hiện tại đang được "chiết khấu" cực kỳ đẹp quanh vùng $1,730 (khoảng hơn 44 triệu VND). Lý do để gom ETH ngay hôm nay?

title: BTC Holds $65K as Derivatives Signal Caution While ETH Leads Spot Recovery
subTitle:
One metric tells you more about market positioning than a hundred price charts: the funding rate. Right now, $BTC sits at $65,103.92 on Binance, up 1.48% over the last 24 hours with $808.31 million in spot volume, according to CoinMarketCap. $ETH is outperforming in percentage terms at $1,763.56, up 2.11% on $347.41 million in volume, with a market capitalization of $212.82 billion versus Bitcoin's $1.30 trillion. The spot tape looks constructive. But the derivatives tape is telling a more complicated story.

Let us walk through what the data says.

The US dollar index has pushed to its highest level since May 2025, a macro headwind that historically compresses crypto valuations. When the dollar strengthens, risk assets across the board face selling pressure from a liquidity perspective. The fact that $BTC has managed to hold above $65,000 in this environment is not insignificant. Prior dollar-strength cycles in late 2024 and early 2025 saw Bitcoin retest lower ranges before resuming uptrends. The current resilience suggests spot demand is absorbing macro-driven selling rather than capitulating to it.

That said, open interest in perpetual futures remains elevated relative to realized volatility. When open interest outpaces actual price movement, it means the market is carrying a heavy directional bet that has not yet resolved. Funding rates across major venues have drifted from deeply negative territory toward neutral over the past week. This is consistent with a market that was heavily short, is now unwinding those positions, but has not yet flipped aggressively long. Translation: shorts are covering, but fresh long leverage has not piled in at scale. That is a healthier setup than the alternative.

The volume distribution tells a parallel story. Bitcoin's 24-hour volume of $808.31 million is adequate but not euphoric. Compare this to the multi-billion-dollar daily volumes seen during the March and November 2025 breakout sessions. The absence of volume expansion on a green day suggests this is a relief move, not the start of a new impulse. Options skew data, where available, corroborates this: traders are still paying a slight premium for downside protection over upside calls. Fear has not fully exited the building.

Ethereum's relative outperformance at plus 2.11% versus Bitcoin's plus 1.48% is worth noting. In prior cycles, ETH outperformance during BTC consolidation phases often preceded a broader altcoin rotation. The notable movers on CoinMarketCap today, DEXE up 24.7% and UB up 22.1%, hint that selective risk appetite is returning to smaller caps. However, these are single-session moves on potentially thin books. The signal is real but the sample size is one day.

What would invalidate the current read? A sharp funding rate spike into deeply positive territory combined with rising open interest would signal that leverage longs are crowding in. Historically, that setup precedes a flush. Alternatively, a sustained break below $63,000 for $BTC on expanding volume would flip the structure bearish and likely drag $ETH below the $1,700 support band.

There are also idiosyncratic factors at play. The Bank of England easing stablecoin rules with a 40 billion pound issuance cap is a structural positive for on-chain liquidity in GBP-denominated markets over the medium term. Meanwhile, Q2 2026 being the most-hacked quarter on record with 83 incidents is a reminder that protocol-level risk remains elevated and that security narratives will increasingly influence capital allocation. EUR trading accounting for just 1% of Binance spot volume, as CryptoQuant reports, underscores how dominant USD and USDT pairs remain in price discovery.

The probabilistic read: this looks like a mid-cycle consolidation within a broader uptrend. Funding normalization, moderate volume, and dollar-strength resilience all point to a market digesting gains rather than distributing. The asymmetry favors spot accumulation over leveraged positioning at current levels.

The trade here is patience, not conviction. Let the derivatives market tip its hand before committing directional.

What derivatives signal are you watching most closely right now? Funding rates, open interest, or options skew?

Not financial advice.

Data over drama.

title: Taiko Halts Ethereum L2 Block Production After $1.7 Million Bridge Exploit
subTitle:
Ethereum Layer 2 project Taiko confirmed a chain state verification compromise leading to a $1.7M bridge drain. The team halted block production and urged immediate withdrawals as TAIKO token dropped sharply.

Ethereum Layer 2 scaling solution Taiko has taken its network offline after a security incident compromised its bridge infrastructure, marking the latest high-profile exploit in the DeFi space.
The project announced on X that it had confirmed a compromise of Taiko’s chain state verification mechanism. As a result, “the security assumptions of all bridges deployed on Taiko can no longer be relied upon.” The team strongly advised all users to withdraw funds from bridges immediately while coordinating with its Security Council.
⚠️ Security Notice

1/2: We have confirmed a compromise of Taiko’s chain state verification mechanism. As a result, the security assumptions of all bridges deployed on Taiko can no longer be relied upon.

We are actively coordinating with the Security Council and ecosystem…— Taiko.eth 🥁 (@taikoxyz) June 22, 2026
Blockchain security firm Blockaid first flagged the ongoing exploit targeting Taiko’s ERC20 Vault on Ethereum. The attacker forged message proofs that were accepted on Ethereum L1 without corresponding legitimate events on the Taiko source chain, allowing unauthorized asset withdrawals estimated at $1.7 million, including significant amounts of USDC, ETH, and TAIKO tokens.
In response, Taiko halted all block production to contain the damage. The team paused affected contracts, including the L1 Bridge and ERC20 Vault, and requested centralized exchanges to suspend TAIKO deposits. Subsequent updates indicated the exploit was contained, with no further losses reported.
The incident comes amid a broader wave of exploits, with over 20 crypto hacks recorded in June 2026 alone. Taiko, which positions itself as a decentralized, Ethereum-equivalent rollup using zk-proofs, had launched its mainnet relatively recently. The exploit highlights persistent challenges in bridge security and proof verification systems across Layer 2 solutions.
TAIKO token reacted sharply, dropping approximately 10% in the hours following the announcement, trading near lows around $0.075-$0.08. Stolen assets, including roughly 1.99 million TAIKO tokens, were reportedly moved toward exchanges like MEXC.
Taiko has promised a full post-mortem and indicated potential technical and legal actions against the attacker, including address blacklisting. Users with assets on Taiko bridges are advised to act promptly and monitor official channels for recovery updates and reopening timelines.
This event underscores ongoing risks in cross-chain infrastructure even as the broader Ethereum ecosystem matures. While the quick response limited damage compared to larger historical bridge hacks, it serves as a reminder for projects and users to prioritize security assumptions and rapid incident response.

The truth about losing money in the crypto space is that often it's not because the market is bad, but because you're randomly picking, buying, and holding.

I've heard a lot of folks around me saying they've been wrecked lately, but when I check their watchlists, the problem is glaringly obvious: it's not that they can't trade; they're just touching some "zombie coins" they shouldn't even consider.

There are three types of coins I basically skip over.

First type: "Zombie coins" with terrible liquidity.

Their trading volume is pitiful; it seems like they're fluctuating every day, but when you actually want to sell, there's no one to take your bag.

What you buy in is the price; trying to exit turns into "slippage hell," and in the end, you're not just losing—you're stuck.

The problem with these coins isn't just that they drop; it's that you simply have no exit strategy.

Second type: "Bottomless pit coins" with unstable rules.

Today there's a token unlock, tomorrow there's a new issuance, and the project mechanics can change on a whim.

You think you're investing, but you're actually just gambling on the project's rules.

The biggest issue with these coins isn't volatility; it's the ridiculously high uncertainty.

Third type: "Narrative coins" that only tell stories.

If AI is hot, they're all about AI; if RWA is trending, they swap to RWA, and they cycle through Web3 and GameFi.

They seem to be "evolving," but in reality, there's no core foundation.

The more stories there are, the higher the risk, because eventually, you have to deliver.

Removing these three types from your watchlist can actually help you dodge a significant chunk of potential losses.

Many people lose money not in trading, but because they already made mistakes in the "selection phase."

So what should you be looking at?

In simple terms, three things: those with real cash flow or actual users;

teams that are publicly active, not just narrating;

and those that got unfairly wrecked in a down market but still have solid fundamentals.

During a bear market, these coins will drop together, but the difference is: some drop due to emotions, while others drop because they're dead.

Real projects that are still alive have teams that are working, products that are updating, and communities that are maintaining.

When market sentiment warms up, these are often the first to rebound.

Right now, the market isn't lacking opportunities; what's missing is patience and the ability to filter.

The colder it gets, the slower you should be; don't rush to enter the market but rather filter out the garbage first.

At the end of the day, in one sentence: the most expensive thing in crypto isn't missing an opportunity; it's wasting your capital on the wrong stuff. $HYPE $BTC $ID

币圈亏钱的真相，很多时候不是行情不好，而是你自己在乱选、乱买、乱扛。

我身边不少人最近都在说亏麻了，但我一看他们的自选列表，其实问题一眼就能看出来：不是不会做，是在碰一些“根本不该碰的东西”。

有三类币，我基本是直接略过的。

第一类：流动性很差的“僵尸币”

成交量小得可怜，看起来每天都在波动，但真要出货的时候根本没人接。

你买进去是价格，想出来就变成“滑点地狱”，最后不是亏，是被卡死。

这种币的问题不是跌，而是你根本没有退出权。

第二类：规则不稳定的“无底洞币”

今天一个解锁，明天一个增发，甚至项目机制说改就改。

你以为自己在投资，其实是在陪项目方赌规则。

这种币最大的问题不是波动，是不确定性太高。

第三类：只会讲故事的“题材币”

AI热就讲AI，RWA热就换RWA，Web3、GameFi轮着来一遍。

看起来一直在“进化”，实际上就是没有核心落地。

故事越多，风险越大，因为最后总要兑现。

把这三类从自选里删掉，其实已经帮你挡掉一大半亏损来源了。

很多人亏钱，不是在交易，是在“筛选阶段就已经错了”。

那什么才值得看？

简单说就三点：有真实现金流或者实际用户的；

团队是公开做事，而不是只在叙事；

在行情不好时被错杀，但基本面还在的。

熊市里这些币会一起跌，但区别在于：有的跌是情绪，有的跌是死亡。

真正活着的项目，团队还在干活，产品还在更新，社区还在维持。

等市场情绪回暖，先动的往往就是这些。

现在市场其实不缺机会，缺的是耐心和筛选能力。

越是冷的时候，越要慢一点，不要急着进场，而是先把垃圾过滤掉。

说到底一句话：币圈最贵的，不是错过机会，而是你一直在错误的东西里浪费本金。$HYPE $BTC $ID
